H.name: human-driven
H.trigger: A person in one of our apps
H.response_p95: 2 s to acknowledge, 10 s to finish
H.on_failure: The app shows the error at once and keeps the person's edit

E.name: event-driven
E.trigger: A machine event from our side: a push, a tag, a merge, a deploy
E.on_failure: Retry with backoff, then alert in Slack

S.name: scheduled
S.on_failure: The next run catches up; two misses alert

M.name: manual setup
M.trigger: A person following steps outside our code
M.on_failure: A checklist step stays open until check() confirms it
